reason: I'd ask for the free sample, because a fermented, less sweet base is exactly what I'm hunting for my no-alcohol list. But at 23 euros a litre I can't swap it in for Monin on mocktails I sell at 7 or 8 euros. That would eat my margin, so this month nothing goes on the order.
objection: 23 euros a litre is two to three times what I pay for Monin, and I don't know yet how many drinks I get out of a litre or whether it holds once it's open behind a hot bar.
would_change_my_mind: If the sample shows a litre makes clearly more drinks than Monin (smaller dose per glass), so the cost per mocktail ends up close to what I pay now, I'd put one signature drink on the menu with it.
